customer_name: Hanhua Financial Holding Co., Ltd. (瀚华金控股份有限公司)
business_problem: Hanhua Financial Holding needed to serve nationally distributed SMEs with financing products that could adapt quickly to market and policy changes, while reducing manual processing cost and improving risk control across the full lending lifecycle.
solution_summary: Hanhua Financial Holding built the online supply-chain finance platform Hanhua Yunlian on Tencent Cloud to digitize SME lending from application through repayment and ongoing risk control. A Mini Program front end handles self-service applications, while an intelligent decision engine and big-data risk-control services support pre-loan screening, in-loan control, and post-loan monitoring. Hanhua added enterprise identity verification, remote electronic signing, and quantitative risk-decision modules so customers could complete financing workflows online instead of through fragmented offline channels. Open APIs connect application intake, credit, disbursement, and repayment with core enterprises, industry platforms, and partner banks, turning the platform into both Hanhua's digital operating backbone and its ecosystem integration layer for supply-chain finance.

solution_components.name: Hanhua Yunlian
solution_components.role: Serves as the online supply-chain finance platform through which enterprises access financing workflows.

solution_components.name: Mini Program
solution_components.role: Provides the front-end self-service channel for SME applications and customer interactions.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Decision Engine
solution_components.role: Automates financing decisions and rule-driven risk assessment during loan processing.

solution_components.name: Big Data Risk Control
solution_components.role: Supports risk screening, control, and monitoring across pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan stages.

solution_components.name: Open APIs
solution_components.role: Connect origination, credit, disbursement, and repayment services with external ecosystem partners.

data_flow: SMEs enter Hanhua Yunlian through the Mini Program, where identity verification and remote signing prepare financing requests for the Intelligent Decision Engine and Big Data Risk Control modules. Approved workflows then pass through Open APIs that connect core enterprises, industry platforms, and partner banks for credit, disbursement, repayment, and ongoing risk monitoring.
business_outcome: Hanhua digitized financing channels for SMEs, shortened manual workflows, improved customer experience, and created a real-time partner ecosystem that supports lower-cost financing with fuller risk visibility across the loan lifecycle.
metrics: The group has served more than 200,000 SMEs over 10+ years.
SMEs and agriculture-related customers account for 78% of the group's customers.
The platform's first engineering guarantee transaction went live in November 2020.
The first live transaction was completed fully online by a customer from Sichuan.
architecture_clues: The platform digitizes the full flow of pre-loan screening, in-loan control, and post-loan risk monitoring.
Enterprise identity authentication, remote e-signing, and quantified risk decisioning are built into the financing flow.
The API layer exposes intake, credit, disbursement, and repayment services for ecosystem partners.
Future scenarios named in the source include bidding loans, construction-start loans, and home-appliance loans.
evidence_quotes: Hanhua built the online supply-chain finance platform 'Hanhua Yunlian' to solve financing difficulties and high financing costs for SMEs (original: 打造的供应链金融线上服务平台“瀚华云链”…有效解决了产业链上中小企业融资难、融资贵问题).

The platform uses a Mini Program, an intelligent decision engine, and big-data risk control to build modules for digital identity authentication, remote electronic signing, and quantitative risk decisioning (original: 通过小程序、智能决策引擎、大数据风控等技术手段…建成了企业数字身份认证、远程电子签约、量化风控决策等系统模块).
It digitizes the full lending lifecycle with pre-loan risk screening, in-loan risk control, and post-loan risk monitoring (original: 实现贷前风险筛查、贷中风险控制、贷后风险监控的全流程数字化运行).

Open APIs for application intake, credit, disbursement, and repayment create real-time digital channels with core enterprises, industry platforms, and banks (original: 通过打造进件、授信、放款、还款等开放 API 能力，与核心企业、产业平台、银行等生态合作伙伴建立起实时交互的数字化通道).
In November 2020 the engineering-guarantee product went live and the first transaction was completed end to end online by the customer (original: 2020年11月，平台已上线工程保函产品…由客户全流程线上自助完成).
